ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with sparse, localized high-intensity (white) points. Macro-level ratio is heavily weighted towards low-intensity pixels (approx. 95% dark coverage).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-gray/black region across the entire surface area with discrete, isolated, roughly circular high-contrast blobs (mottling) scattered asymmetrically across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex angle approximately 40-45 degrees from the horizontal midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations across the entire continuous boundary; notable jagged peaks and valleys with extreme irregularity concentrated at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward and outward sweep from the median notch, following a curve that is slightly convex near the center and transitioning to concave toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 14 high-contrast, light-colored circular pixel clusters (ranging 5-15 pixels in diameter) scattered across the mid-section of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular morphology and suspected tissue loss at both lateral tips, exhibiting significant pixel-level jaggedness inconsistent with standard biological growth.
